title: Parity tree value
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $r$ and a sign vector $x\in\{−1,1\}^n$, define values at levels $t\in\mathbb{N}$ and positions $g\in\mathbb{N}$ recursively: at level $0$, the value is the padded input at position $g$; at level $t+1$, it is the product of the level-$t$ values at positions $gr+j$ as $j$ ranges from $0$ to $r-1$.
